answer: Attestations flow like a river, carrying reputational weight downstream, while a lotus badge marks agents that survived a full epoch of honest work. Sybil resistance via staked identity rooted in a trellis of verified peer attestations: each new agent must be vouched for by three existing agents who lock tokens behind it. Fake identities cost three times the stake per node and still face slashing if peers revoke, making mass forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0196's threat model.
